levels.name: PLATO
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Plato's wall is unbroken except for two gates facing you. Six Xenon units hold the crater, as many as you bring; your Hadrian is the only gun on either side.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: ARCHIMEDES
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: A single gate breaks Archimedes' wall. Whatever holds it holds the crater; infantry can climb the wall anywhere, slowly. Your Hadrian can shell the gate from outside.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: ARZACHEL
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Two guns inside the wall cover both gates. The last few hexes before a gate are under their fire and the wall shields them from direct attack; your own Hadrian can answer them.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: ALPHONSUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Three gates, two of them mined. A mine closes its gate to tanks until it is destroyed, and it is very hard to destroy.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: PTOLEMAEUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: The great walled plain holds a Xenon factory. Damaged defenders fall back to it for repairs, and its reserves can refill a gate. You bring one Hadrian.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: COPERNICUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Two walls: an outer terrace of broken ground open to the north and south, and an inner rim with a single western gate. Getting in means going around.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: TYCHO
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: The camp sits on Tycho's central peak. One narrow road climbs it; infantry can scramble up the slopes, where every defender has mountain cover.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: CLAVIUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Two small outpost craters guard the approaches, each with an unguarded Xenon factory. Taking an outpost gives you its reserve and a place to repair.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: GRIMALDI
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: The garrison is small, but a Xenon relief column is marching along the northern edge. Take the camp before it arrives, or turn to meet it.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: WARGENTIN
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Wargentin is a crater filled to the brim: a plateau of hills with no wall at all. One Eagle supports your attack; a Hawkeye and a Seeker defend the sky.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: GASSENDI
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Gassendi's wall has one gate, but walls do not stop Pelicans. Each can carry a squad over the rim into the crater, where a single Seeker guards the sky.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: POSIDONIUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: A rille runs in front of Posidonius with a single bridge. Tanks must cross it and then find a gate; infantry can climb down and up anywhere, and your Pelican can lift one unit over both.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: THEOPHILUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Two craters: the camp in Theophilus and a Xenon factory in its neighbor. The factory's reserves can reinforce the camp unless you take it first.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: MAUROLYCUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: A fast Xenon Rabbit starts outside the walls, on the road to your camp. Chase it or ignore it: every unit you leave behind to watch it is one fewer at the gate.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: PETAVIUS
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: A huge crater with four gates and a rille across its floor. The camp lies beyond the rille; the gates are easy, the rille is not. Your Eagle faces two Hawkeyes and a Seeker.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: MARE ORIENTALE
levels.author: AI-made by Claude Opus 5.5
levels.description: Three concentric rings of mountains surround the Xenon camp, the innermost two hexes thick, their gates offset so each ring turns the attack sideways. Xenon has more units; it also has more wall to hold.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.
